notes.title: Merry Christmas
notes.content:
Dear Fans

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33019449/b0768830b5eaa1c91423f1ac2bb2bea6772c5d62.png

Christmas is just around the door, so we would like to wish you all the best during this Christmas. We hope that you get lots of nice gifts and have great time, among your loved ones!

Next year will mark the anniversary for Tuomo's Games, so there's going to be lots of good things in store for both old and new fans. It's thanks to all of you, who help keep the dream of making games for livelihood alive. Thank you for your support and all the feedback that you give, as it helps the games become better in future.


Wishing you the best,
Tuomo

notes.title: Border of her Heart will have a sequel
notes.content:
I am pleased to tell Border of her Heart fans that the game will have a sequel

The game will take place after events of the first game, however playing the first game won't be necessary as location and the people involved are all different. Some events you'll appreciate a bit more though, if you know the context to them, such as the plague.

Wishlist it today, as we'll have a small playable demo later this month!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592590/Border_of_her_Heart_2/

notes.title: Important Linux update!
notes.content:
Greetings Linux users! After long time and many trials, the file structure of Border of her Heart Linux version was totally changed including the deployement method. This huge update for Linux users should make the game playable if you used to have problems before.

Thank you from your patience and understanding, this took a lot of hard work and testing to get working. I hope you'll have fun playing Border of her Heart!

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31941310/5d9793ed5189cbab6236c007afcd68728433b4aa.png

Achievements

Game now features achievements

Audio

Missing narration during battle inside house has been added
All the spoken dialogue has been enhanced and ran through various optimizations for better sound clarity and quality

Bugfix

Memory leak issues when loading game due to engine have been resolved
Problems occuring from loading game due to engine have been resolved
Problems with sliders due to engine have been resolved
Declining cheating with Helewisa while having nightshift event occur caused Helewisa's sprite to remain on screen, this has been fixed

Gameplay

Getting any of the endings now no longer exits the game but rather, boots you to the title screen

Graphics

Helewisa's position was off when going into date with her with HD DLC enabled, she's now positioned correctly

Performance

Numerous small performance tweaks

Transitions

Changed scene transition menthods to reduce load times when returning back to tent after each day
